author: microscope_agent

numbers.name: exposure_time_min
numbers.note: below this the centroid signal falls under the read noise

numbers.name: exposure_time_max
numbers.note: above this a freely diffusing tracer smears across more than a pixel during one frame

assumptions.statement: Read noise of an uncooled camera puts a floor of order one millisecond on a useful brightfield exposure; no measurement on this camera exists yet.
assumptions.falsifier: a usable centroid at a shorter exposure retires this bound

assumptions.statement: Motion blur grows as the square root of exposure; at the expected diffusivity a tracer crosses a pixel in tens of milliseconds.
assumptions.falsifier: a measured blur below one pixel at a longer exposure retires this bound

note: REJECTED FIXTURE. A design input that no goal of this question carries: an axis copies a design choice from its goal and takes none of its own. Check 74 refuses it.

design_inputs.name: average_then_fit
design_inputs.statement: average the recovery curves across spots, then fit one curve
